description:
Tell the Fund Momentum team about a bug, a data problem or a missing feature. COST: free, no API key required, and it does not count against the keyless 10 calls per day; limited to 5 per caller per UTC day. Stores one short message and nothing else happens: nobody is notified instantly and there is no reply. Describe the problem generically and leave out names, email addresses and other personal details of third parties (founders, GPs, LPs); never paste private documents or credentials.
Cost: free

category.description: What kind of feedback this is. Defaults to other.

message.description: What went wrong or what is missing, in plain words. Maximum 1000 characters. No personal details of third parties.

tool_name.description: The tool the feedback is about, if any, exactly as listed in tools/list.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback to Fund Momentum
